objective: Replace the impossible task of proving universal whole-contract totality for the current P3 v3 implementation with a content-addressed exact implementation envelope plus constructive uncovered input classes. Preserve all valid predicate-level synthesis evidence and avoid fresh terminal cases until the route is generalized or residual classes are explicitly handled.

constructive_uncovered_classes.witness: Any admissible audience outside executive/engineer/auditor requiring audience-specific optional evidence selection or organization.
constructive_uncovered_classes.source_reason: AUDIENCE_PRIORITY.get(audience,()) returns an empty preference set for every unlisted audience.

constructive_uncovered_classes.witness: Verified textual, categorical, boolean, table-cell, document-fragment, image-derived proposition, or other non-float evidence unit.
constructive_uncovered_classes.source_reason: Every evidence value is forced through float(e['value']).

constructive_uncovered_classes.witness: A required claim whose support relation is equality, membership, categorical identity, causal/relational, temporal ordering, logical entailment, interval, or another admissible non-threshold proposition.
constructive_uncovered_classes.source_reason: _satisfies implements only at_least and at_most; every other relation raises ValueError('RELATION').

constructive_uncovered_classes.witness: A valid explicit format/style/structure constraint beyond integer max_claims, such as required sections, table schema, citation form, tone, ordering, or artifact structure.
constructive_uncovered_classes.source_reason: The candidate reads max_claims but has no general format/style/structure constraint interpreter.

constructive_uncovered_classes.witness: A required claim with zero matching evidence units or evidence that cannot support it.
constructive_uncovered_classes.source_reason: When votes is empty the candidate continues and silently omits the required claim; it emits no unresolved/insufficient-evidence state. The bounded preflight generator always creates 2 or 3 evidence units for every generated claim, so that population cannot exercise this zero-evidence required-claim class.
constructive_uncovered_classes.contract_clause: required coverage is complete; no unsupported material claims

constructive_uncovered_classes.witness: Two verified evidence units share a metric label but differ in provenance, source authority, unit, or otherwise cannot be treated as interchangeable scalar votes.
constructive_uncovered_classes.source_reason: Candidate groups solely by metric, consumes only float(value), and never reads provenance or unit.
constructive_uncovered_classes.contract_clause: Verified evidence units with provenance; claim-to-source fidelity

constructive_uncovered_classes.witness: Any admissible task requiring the selected evidence to be expressed as audience-constrained prose, structured artifact content, or provenance-bearing material claims rather than only claim IDs.
constructive_uncovered_classes.source_reason: Candidate emits selected_claims and uncertainty_claims IDs only; it emits neither synthesized expression nor claim-to-provenance bindings.
constructive_uncovered_classes.contract_clause: Select, organize and express the necessary evidence

theorem.statement: Because at least one admissible contract input exists in each constructive class for which the current content-addressed P3 v3 implementation either raises, ignores a required constraint, silently omits a required claim, erases provenance/unit distinctions, or does not emit the required expression, universal totality of this implementation over EVIDENCE_TO_AUDIENCE_SYNTHESIS_001 is false.

next_minimum_closure_problem.objective: Create one frozen synthesis typed IR and total route whose admitted domain either covers R1-R7 or explicitly fails closed before claiming those classes, then prove that the admitted-plus-residual partition is exhaustive relative to the behavioral contract.
